## Summary
Implement Supabase Auth with magic link (passwordless email) login, session management, and auth middleware so all downstream E02 stories have a working authentication layer.

## User story
As an admin or faculty member, I want to log in via magic link email, so that I can securely access Journey OS without managing passwords.

## Why this matters
Without auth, no page in the admin panel is protected. Any unauthenticated user could access FERPA-sensitive student data. This is the security foundation for the entire platform.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Magic link email is sent via Supabase Auth when user enters valid email on /login
- [ ] Auth callback route exchanges code for session and redirects to dashboard
- [ ] Session route returns current user + role (admin/faculty/student) or 401
- [ ] Next.js middleware redirects unauthenticated users to /login for all (admin) routes
- [ ] AuthGuard client component shows loading state during session check
- [ ] RLS policies on all tables enforce institution_id scoping via auth.uid()
- [ ] Invalid/expired magic links show user-friendly error, not a crash

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Data Layer | createServerClient() in API routes (service_role for callback), createBrowserClient() in client components |
| Data Layer | Row<'table'> from @journey/db/client for any profile/user types |
| Atomic Design | LoginForm is an organism in features/auth/components/, page.tsx < 30 lines |
| RLS | institution_id scoped — every table policy uses auth.uid() to resolve institution |

## Schema changes
```sql
-- profiles table (if not already in E01)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.profiles (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  institution_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.institutions(id),
  role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'faculty', 'student')),
  display_name TEXT,
  email TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- RLS
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Users can read own profile"
  ON public.profiles FOR SELECT
  USING (auth.uid() = id);
CREATE POLICY "Users can read profiles in same institution"
  ON public.profiles FOR SELECT
  USING (institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid()));
```

## API contract
```
GET /app/api/auth/session
Headers: Cookie (Supabase session cookie)
Response 200: { data: { user: { id, email, role, institution_id } }, error: null }
Response 401: { data: null, error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'Not authenticated' } }

GET /app/api/auth/callback?code=XXX
Redirects to: /dashboard (on success) or /login?error=auth_failed (on failure)
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/auth/services/AuthService.ts
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/client';

export class AuthService {
  async getSession() {
    const supabase = createServerClient();
    const { data: { session }, error } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
    if (error || !session) return null;
    return session;
  }

  async signInWithMagicLink(email: string) {
    const supabase = createServerClient();
    return supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({
      email,
      options: { emailRedirectTo: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/api/auth/callback` }
    });
  }
}

// app/(auth)/login/page.tsx — must be < 30 lines
import { LoginForm } from '@/features/auth/components/LoginForm';
export default function LoginPage() {
  return <LoginForm />;
}
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E02/E02-S01.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('GET /api/auth/session returns 401 when not authenticated', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get('/api/auth/session');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(401);
  const body = await res.json();
  expect(body.error.code).toBe('UNAUTHORIZED');
});

test('GET /api/auth/callback without code redirects to login with error', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get('/api/auth/callback', { maxRedirects: 0 });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(302);
  expect(res.headers()['location']).toContain('/login?error=');
});

// tests/E02/E02-S01.ui.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('Login page renders magic link form', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/login');
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: /sign in/i })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByPlaceholder(/email/i)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /send.*link/i })).toBeVisible();
});

test('Login form validates email before submission', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/login');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /send.*link/i }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText(/valid email/i)).toBeVisible();
});

test('Unauthenticated user visiting /dashboard is redirected to /login', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/dashboard');
  await page.waitForURL('**/login**');
  expect(page.url()).toContain('/login');
});
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.profiles CASCADE;`
2. No Neo4j changes to revert.
3. `git stash && git checkout develop`
